subject: Request: Standby GPU allocation + soft reservation hold for NovaQ pilot
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara@novaq.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask: standby H200 allocation + soft reservation hold

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. NovaQ is moving quickly — the execs want a 6-week pilot that will drive a hard traffic spike during our model migration (Aug 29 - Sep 10). To make the pilot realistic we need three concessions: 

1) Standby allocation / "soft reservation hold" for the pilot window so our jobs aren't preempted during the migration. We won't fully commit to a new long-term reservation yet, but we need capacity guarantees for the 6-week run.
2) H200 class GPUs for the pilot (our model needs FP16 throughput). We understand Redwood defaults to H100 for new Dedicated bookings; we need H200 for latency targets.
3) A temporary overage-floor and reduced overage rate for burst tokens for the first 90 days of production — our finance team wants a predictable first-quarter cost envelope.

Estimated committed spend (if pilot converts): ~$95k/mo. Attached is an updated MAP and our usage estimates. Can your deal desk/execs sign off? If granted we can fast-track PO and e-sign.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Malik
Head of Infrastructure, NovaQ
attachments: MAP_NovaQ_v2.pdf, usage-estimates.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Malik <sara@novaq.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: standby H200 allocation + soft reservation hold

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. We're excited to run this pilot with NovaQ.

Karthik — looping you in to escalate to deal desk / execs. High level asks summarized: standby soft-hold for Aug 29–Oct 10 (6 weeks + buffer), assign H200 pool for pilot (hard constraint), and a 90-day reduced overage rate (percentage TBD).

A couple notes for approval:
- We need to confirm whether finance requires a hard commit to get H200 — typically H200 allocation without commit is limited.
- If we approve standby, we should attach a one-way early termination fee or minimum commitment to protect utilization.

If you want I can prep a redlineable SLA-term-sheet and run pricing scenarios; I attached a draft SLA-term-sheet that legal can start on.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: SLA-term-sheet.docx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — NovaQ pilot exceptions (H200, standby hold, overage discount)

Lauren — need quick signoff to avoid losing momentum. Summary below and recommended concession.

Summary of external ask (from NovaQ):
- Standby "soft reservation hold" for Aug 29–Oct 10 (primary window Aug 29–Sep 10 during migration) to prevent preemption.
- H200 class GPUs for the pilot (8-week H200 assignment requested).
- Temporary reduced overage rate for burst (first 90 days) to cap first-quarter unit economics.

Commercials and risk:
- Potential ARR if pilot converts: ~$1.14M ARR (annualized from $95k/mo).
- Short-term resource risk: H200s have tighter supply; making a non-committed allocation reduces capacity for other customers.
- Reputational upside: NovaQ is a reference account in health AI and can drive logos in our vertical.

My recommended approval (balanced):
1) Approve standby soft-hold for up to 6 weeks (Aug 29–Oct 10) with the following conditions: customer signs a pilot agreement acknowledging that capacity is prioritized but still subject to a graceful fallback to H100 if physical failover necessary; Redwood to provide 48h notice of fallback.
2) Approve H200 assignment for the pilot for up to 8 weeks (Aug 29–Oct 24). After that Redwood may migrate to compatible H100 variants.
3) Offer a 15% discount on standard overage rates for the first 90 days post-production, conditional on NovaQ signing a minimum 3-month committed spend equal to 50% of their estimated monthly usage (protects utilization).

If we approve this as-is, estimated revenue protection (commit) plus pilot converts yields positive economics. The main ask to you: do we accept the 15% overage discount + 50% min commitment or scale back? Also approve the H200 temporary allocation.

I can turn this into an approval email and ask Legal/Finance to draft the amendment once we have signoff.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — NovaQ pilot exceptions (H200, standby hold, overage discount)

Karthik / Vanessa — after reviewing the ask and the business case I approve a constrained concession set with the following terms: 

Approved concessions: 
- Standby soft-reservation hold for Aug 29–Oct 10 (6 weeks) — approved. We will require a pilot addendum that includes a 48-hour fallback clause and a nominal early termination fee ($12,500) if they walk before conversion.
- H200 assignment approved for the pilot window (Aug 29–Sep 30). After Sep 30 Redwood can convert to equivalent H100 hardware with a 72-hour notice. (Shorter H200 window than requested to protect inventory.)
- Overage discount: approve 10% discount on standard overage rates for the first 60 days post-production only. We will not extend 90 days or a 15% discount without a larger committed uplift.

Conditions: 
1) NovaQ to sign the pilot addendum and a minimum 2-month prepaid reservation commitment (50% of estimated monthly usage) by Aug 24.
2) Legal to review SLA-term-sheet and confirm language for fallback and fees.
3) Finance to approve the billing flow (prepay + overage rebate).

Vanessa — please document these changes in HubSpot (deal RDW-DEAL-1983) and route the SLA addendum to Legal/Finance for rapid turnaround. Once we have signed docs, we can lock inventory.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Malik <sara@novaq.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: standby H200 allocation + soft reservation hold — approved (with conditions)

Sara — good news: leadership has approved a constrained concession set. Key bullets below (please confirm acceptance by EOD Aug 24 so we can lock capacity):

- Standby soft-reservation hold: Aug 29–Oct 10 (6 weeks). Redwood will provide a 48-hour notice if fallback to H100 is required. Early termination fee: $12,500 applies if the pilot is canceled before conversion.
- H200 assignment: approved through Sep 30 (we will migrate to H100 thereafter with 72-hour notice if needed).
- Overage pricing: 10% discount on standard overage for the first 60 days after production.
- Commit: 2-month prepay equal to 50% of your estimated monthly usage (see attached usage-estimates.xlsx).

Next steps: 
1) I attached the SLA-term-sheet and MAP; Legal will prepare a pilot addendum for signature.
2) I will create a DocuSign envelope (link below) for the pilot addendum and the 2-month prepay invoice.
3) Please confirm acceptance and we will reserve H200 capacity pending signed docs and prepay.

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.redwood.com/env/XYZ-789
HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-DEAL-1983

Looking forward — we want to make the pilot seamless.

—Vanessa
